title: L3: Binary Mine
description: Mine and combine elements. Combining two elements adds their binary codes together — the sum is a brand-new element. Climb as high as you can on the class leaderboard.

steps.title: Binary Mine
steps.content:
Binary Mine

Every block is an element with a binary code. To mine a block you need a pickaxe that is strong enough. You make stronger pickaxes by combining two elements — and combining is just binary addition: the two codes add together to make a new element.

Mine
Left-click a block
Build
Right-click the sky
Combine
0110 + 1100 = 10010
Goal
Discover the highest element
